entries.name: Ordre de repli du commandant du SGC
entries.sourceWork: Stargate SG-1, Season1 (1997), Major General George Hammond at Stargate Command
entries.appearance: Older stocky adult human man, bald crown and short pale-gray hair at the sides, clean-shaven round face, dark-blue USAF service jacket and trousers, light-blue shirt, black tie, two silver general stars on shoulder boards, dark shoes; no helmet, armor or carried gun
entries.weapon: empty hands and concrete SGC command briefing / withdrawal instructions; no portable iris, stargate or staff weapon
entries.actionName: Ordre de repli du commandant du SGC
entries.pose: Give a clear human briefing and indicate a safe retreat with empty hands. No gun, beam, healing ray, portal or iris appears on the body.
entries.notes: Ordinary human command role. Four-pose gestures and temporary team protection adapt a concrete withdrawal instruction, not a supernatural shield or a remotely available iris. Simplified service-uniform illustration is not a certified actor likeness or official source frame.
